input.name: seeds-from-a-read
input.covers: Opening and synchronous getters do no reads. ensureLoaded starts both reads, keeps snapshots null until settled, and emits resynced separately.

input.name: a-failed-seed-read-is-ignored
input.covers: An on-demand read failure rejects its caller, leaves null metadata/error status, and reports nothing; custom success stays ready.

input.name: live-updates-from-the-event-stream
input.covers: Both origins fold confirmed standard/custom facts. Unrelated facts are ignored; close releases the instance and reopen begins idle.

input.name: update-writes-through-and-sets
input.covers: The three-state standard patch reaches the engine unchanged. Only its confirmed event changes the mirror, before the structured write result settles.

input.name: update-refused
input.covers: An engine refusal rejects update and preserves the complete ready snapshots.

input.name: reload
input.covers: refresh re-reads only the standard mirror; a failed refresh rejects and leaves its last value with error status.

input.name: can-edit
input.covers: canUpdate is the doc.metadata.modify authority for both write surfaces, wildcard included, without loading.

input.name: update-without-the-capability-is-refused-locally
input.covers: Both writes reject permission-denied before any engine write and preserve snapshots/status.

input.name: a-forbidden-seed-read
input.covers: An explicit first load may be forbidden; plain refresh failure is error; a later successful refresh recovers ready.

input.name: status-while-the-seed-read-is-in-flight
input.covers: Loading is explicit. Concurrent ensureLoaded shares both reads; refresh joins the promise and queues one standard re-read.

input.name: an-event-during-the-seed-read-wins
input.covers: New standard and custom confirmed values win over both older in-flight load answers.

input.name: closing-during-the-seed-read
input.covers: Close cancels the explicit load, suppresses late results/callbacks, and reopen starts with fresh idle mirrors.

input.name: on-updated-reports-each-confirmed-change
input.covers: Loads emit resynced; facts emit updated with full previous/changedKeys/origin. Custom key reordering compares equal; unsubscribing silences listeners.

input.name: changed-keys-beyond-the-info-dict
input.covers: Custom keys are flat strings; shallow comparison records changed, added and removed keys and ignores equal/reordered entries.

input.name: custom-write-confirms-before-settlement
input.covers: Custom patches set, clear and omit independently of standard fields; deferred engine confirmation fires before the returned result settles.

input.name: standard-write-does-not-project-unconfirmed-result
input.covers: A returned engine value alone does not update the mirror; only a confirmed fact does.

input.name: custom-refresh-and-refusal
input.covers: Custom refresh and engine write refusal leave the standard mirror intact.
